# Copilot Instructions

- Always run installs, scripts, tests, and scaffolding with **Bun**.
- After finishing any feature work, immediately drive an end-to-end user flow with **#playwright** MCP to capture screenshots and validate behavior; polish the UI if it looks rough before closing the task.
- Reach for **#context7** whenever a tech stack detail is unclear or an error loop persists.
- Keep the UI sharp: rely on the Shadcn CLI via `bunx shadcn@latest add -name` to pull components and ensure visual consistency.
- Before starting or wrapping a task, review and update `todo.md` so planned feature branches and identifiers stay accurate.
